Calculate charge balance

Source: R/calculations.R
charge_balance.Rd

Calculates charge balances based on ALS formula. Note: Original EMS charge balances, anion sums and cation sums will be renamed to charge_balance_enmods, anion_sum_enmods, cation_sum_enmods, respectively, when these are added to samples data (see fmt_minimal()).

Usage

charge_balance(samples)

Arguments

samples

Data frame. Output from fmt_minimal() or fetch_renmods(). If fetch_renmods() samples will be first formatted with fmt_minimal().

Value

Data frame with only cation and anion sums, and charge balance values.

Details

Potential changes in workflows over the years have made it difficult to ascertain exactly how charge balances were calculated in older samples. This resulted in discrepancies between EMS and locally calculated charge balances. Therefore for consistency, we calculate charge balances for all samples using the ALS formula below.

One difference between this calculation and that of ALS, is that we use more significant digits when calculating MEQ.

anion sum = chloride_dissolved_meq/l + sulfate_dissolved_meq/l + fluoride_dissolved_meq/l + nitrate_no3_dissolved_meq/l + nitrogen_nitrite_dissolved_no2_meq/l + alkalinity_total_4.5_as_caco3_meq/l

cation sum = calcium_dissolved_meq/l + magnesium_dissolved_meq/l + sodium_dissolved_meq/l + potassium_dissolved_meq/l + aluminum_dissolved_meq/l + copper_dissolved_meq/l + iron_dissolved_meq/l + manganese_dissolved_meq/l + zinc_dissolved_meq/l + nitrogen_ammonia_dissolved_meq/l + (10 ^ (-ph)) * 1000

Charge balance = 100 x (Cation Sum - Anion sum) / (Cation Sum + Anion Sum)

Missing values are ignored (ie. generally treated as 0). However, if all values for cations or anions are missing the charge balance is NA.

If there are multiple measures for the same observation (i.e. repeated measures), we use the mean MEQ value for that parameter.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
s <- fetch_renmods(
  ems_ids = c("1401030", "1401377"),
  date_range = c("2020-01-01", "2022-02-01")
)
charge_balance(s)

s <- fetch_renmods(
  ems_ids = "E102388",
  date_range = c("2026-01-01", "2027-01-01")
)
charge_balance(s)
}
